notes.title: Enter the Tower!
notes.notes:
[b]100 Steps is a roguelite tower crawler that throws you into the role of a hero trying to top the Tower. There’s not much known about why the Tower exists or who built it, but plenty have tried to conquer its highest floor to snatch up eternal glory.[/b]

You kick off your quest with just 100 moves. Everything you do matters, from cracking open chests to eyeballing your foes. So, how do you plan to reach the 100th floor with those moves? That's where the fun begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/1919ca401178f1cd6d1a63b1630966d5b8126af6.gif[/img]

The game eases you in, but as you go along, you'll need to get clever with the resources you find to make it through. It’s all about figuring out the game’s mechanics to either bend or break the rules to your advantage.

Pick a hero that vibes with your playstyle! Start as the Adventurer, but soon you'll get to choose from 10 unique characters, each with their own stats, weaponry, and passive skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/a46ede9dac84cdd5951b564f8182d7e31ee5a5a6.png[/img]

Your mission is to climb through the levels to the pinnacle of the Tower. Each floor introduces tougher enemies. Fight them or race to the Gate to bypass them—the choice is yours. Every so often, you’ll need to take down a boss to move up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/a0e8cb2771dfa63a9a8130dd1039375d0a3916b0.gif[/img]

Always check the chests you find; they have timers showing how many moves you have before they disappear. They're packed with weapons, health potions, and gear that boosts your stats for a bit or for the rest of your run.

Trinkets are cool little items with special perks—if you meet certain conditions, they give you extra moves to push further upwards.

Now and then, you'll bump into a Vendor and a Forge. Buy items with your collected gold at one, and fix up your gear or upgrade your trinkets at the other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/00ff8b01e6f6b656153cba62390a709cf8a4c08f.gif[/img]

If you trip up and have to start over, make sure to leverage your Feats and Power-ups. Feats help you unlock more heroes and gear for your runs, while Power-ups are upgrades you keep no matter how many times you restart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/b2cae12fa89e5e3ec778d17b6e3a09fb558bd27c.png[/img]

Dive into this lighthearted but challenging roguelite for [b]35% off during Steam Summer Sale[/b]. See if you can outsmart the game and weather the storm of divine fury that comes with breaking the rules.

notes.title: 100 Steps - challenging and unforgivig Tower Crawler
notes.notes:
100 Steps is a roguelite Tower Crawler game where there's one simple rule: the gods grant you 100 steps to ascend the Tower and join their pantheon. 

🏰 Set in a medieval fantasy setting, you'll choose from 10 heroes, each with unique stats and abilities, embarking on a journey through the Tower's floors, collecting items, battling enemies, and devising the best strategies to reach the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/63ea51e680c1067725b573fadb971df223679ff5.png[/img]

You'll navigate a hexagonal grid board where every action—movement, attack, even opening a chest—depletes your step counter. So think carefully before making a move. 💭 

Thankfully, you'll find support in chests containing valuable items like better weapons, area-of-effect spells, and trinkets that directly affect your stats and movement range. Strategize to climb the Tower efficiently. Along your journey, you'll encounter the Vendor and Forge, where you can purchase items or repair and upgrade your existing ones. 🛠️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/45d56c3cd9f9ddcb6a2e2b51207b08642a0deebd.gif[/img]

As you progress, a wider array of items will become available. Completing Feats will earn you new items that may spawn during gameplay, while points collected from each run unlock permanent power-ups, facilitating your ascent.

Did I mention you can break the one rule? There are ways to outsmart the gods and gain extra steps. But beware, exceeding 100 steps will corrupt the world around you, spawning stronger foes in your path. However, you'll gain access to corrupted items whose power surpasses all others. ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/2b374799b729c5d13bf9103d24e68745aa78fdbf.png[/img]

100 Steps is a demanding, unforgiving roguelite Tower Crawler where you'll uncover many systems on your own, but the satisfaction is worth it. [b]The game is currently available for $4.99, and this price is here to stay. 🎮
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/1919ca401178f1cd6d1a63b1630966d5b8126af6.gif[/img]

notes.title: 100 Steps is now available with a 15% launch promo!
notes.notes:
In 100 Steps, you step into the shoes of a daring adventurer, driven by the allure of wealth and a coveted spot among the gods in the Tower's pantheon. There's only one rule: you need climb up the 100 Floors of the Tower and you only have 100 actions to do so. Some claim this is an impossible feat, some claim the one rule can be broken. 

[previewyoutube=GQt7D2vGZQk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Taking the role of one of 10 playable heroes, you will explore the floors of the Tower, collecting weapons and power-ups while confronting formidable enemies. Your strategic choices and judicious use of actions will determine your success as you try to discover ways to bend or break the rules of the game imposed by the Divine. Will you dare anger the Gods themselves to achieve your goal?

notes.title: Break the rules and see the wrath of the gods
notes.notes:
You've become a mere pawn in the game of the divine, where they observe your relentless struggle within the Tower's depths, seeking their amusement. One rule binds you to this place, a mere 100 steps; 100 steps that mark your ascent toward divinity. But can this rule be bent or even broken? 
  
[h1]Enter the Cursed Mode [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/2b374799b729c5d13bf9103d24e68745aa78fdbf.png[/img]
If you are smart, learn the rules and make good use of what fate gives you, you can break One Rule. However, go beyond the threshold of 100 steps, and you'll incur the wrath of the gods, revealing their true nature. Their fury will taint all that surrounds you. 
  
[h2]Empowered Enemies [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/d61bb315fa0bbf3091d301a5cbf6faaec66a654e.png[/img]
This is where the real challenge begins. If you believed you'd outwitted the divine, prepare for a humbling. Even mightier enemies, capable of summoning minions, shall stand in your path. They'll halt at nothing to thwart you. 

[h2]Empowered Items [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/f7b4a9b02d7e344d733126c57c44952e13963df4.png[/img]
Yet, it's not just your foes that grow stronger. The gods' wrath transforms everything it touches. Cursed chests conceal accursed items: weapons, trinkets, potions, and seals imbued with the gods' fury—a destructive force wielded in your hands. Fight fire with fire... or curse with curse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/c4f4474090c57f4827d66739778ec7f71b7ff992.png[/img]
  
[h2]Empowered Improvements [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/3aa76757ed1c7bc9a1ef1f1d84c9d83d860ae4b7.png[/img]
The Vendor and Forge themselves will undergo changes. You can now purchase cursed items from the Vendor or elevate your equipment to previously unattainable heights in the forge. 


What awaits at the tower's top? Assuming you evade the wrath of the gods. No one can say for certain. Nonetheless, should you reach it, before achieving godhood, be ready for one final unwinnable battle!

notes.title: 100 Steps: Know your enemy
notes.notes:
Your adventure commences as you step into the mysterious Tower, a structure of unknown origin that has claimed the lives of countless daring souls throughout the years, all lured by the promise of glory and riches, only to vanish within its enigmatic depths.
You now join their ranks, and the challenges awaiting you are anything but simple. It's time to acquaint yourself with the enemies that will confront you across multiple floors of The Tower.

[h1]Plant enemies[/h1]

[h2]Peta’lin[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/8caf4c7846096bc514f87201ebd35eb666009fde.png[/img]
Peta’lin is a subtle and elusive creature with its body is wrapped in green leaves . It uses its agility to move silently among the foliage, lurking for intruders with rapid and deadly ambushes.

[h2]Frondalith[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/72ada70b48668a05ccbd7e6998b362b3839c400f.png[/img]
Frondalith is a massive and sturdy creature with rock and leaf armor. It moves slowly but is extremely powerful. Its charges can tear the earth apart in its path.

[h2]Frondomer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/255cfb3769fe065f7a79ef1b5b79267cf83dd7f4.png[/img]
Frondomer is an enemy that fuses magic with nature. Its attack s are charged with elemental energy, launching thorn projectiles and electric discharges from its limbs.

[h1]Ice enemies[/h1]

[h2]Cryoskald[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/73b4bc76d7e3031edc7caebcae13af26bba250d4.png[/img]
Cryoskald is an enemy that personifies extreme cold. The ground freezes under its paws, leaving a trail of deadly cold. Don’t be deceived by its adorability.

[h2]Glacialith[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/dbab059751fe7e68509fc299fe260eca38cf9c32.png[/img]
Glacialith is a very furry creature, a true moving mountain of ice and fur. When it moves, the ground trembles, and the air instantly cools.

[h2]Frosthymir[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/24c8dc5cb2104823af9e39c5898262be3f4e5014.png[/img]
Frosthymir, a colossus of the frozen regions. Its ice-blue eyes shine with intelligence and cunning, and its fixed gaze can freeze the heart of any adversary.

[h1]Rock Enemies[/h1]

[h2]Stonarth[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/cc9397c1448083550cabd3cacb50dc0cec7b8416.png[/img]
Stonarth is a robust enemy with rough and rugged stone skin. It can charge with great force.

[h2]Terragon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/209ef38164aac147a32b956ca59b6471822bab6f.png[/img]
Terragon is a gigantic being with natural armor. It movements are slow, but devastating, and it can generate shockwaves that shake the ground and hurl deadly rock fragments with deadly precision. 

[h2]Lithogryph[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/bce18c51c2cb42bec81bc46784d1e0fe49f157e8.png[/img]
Lithogryph is a giant stone creature that rises like a living mountain in the midst of the tower. Cracks and veins in its rock skin reveal a history of a centuries of existence.

These are merely a glimpse of the enemies you shall encounter within this towering labyrinth. Fortunately, you'll stumble upon valuable items and weaponry during your journey, equipping you with the means to conquer even the most formidable foes, as long as you can uncover their weaknesses and formulate your strategies accordingly.

[b]Wishing you the best of luck! May fortune favor your quest![/b]

notes.title: Every move counts, so plan carefully
notes.notes:
In 100 steps it matters what you do, every move counts and your counter goes down. Every time you perform an action in the game, your opponent will also perform a move, the enemy is not sleeping! 

You move on a hexagonal board whose sides consist of 6 hexagonal fields. You have 100 steps, how high can you go in your pursuit of glory? 

[h1]There is a way, there’s always a way [/h1]

Although the task seems difficult, 100 steps to achieve the goal, do not be afraid, you will be able to use some help 

[h2]Attack and collect loot [/h2]

On each floor of the tower, you will encounter enemies who will successively strive to annihilate you. Whether in close combat or from a distance, slain enemies can drop valuable items and coins. Of course, you can always run to the gate, but how long do you think you can avoid fighting? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/a0e8cb2771dfa63a9a8130dd1039375d0a3916b0.gif[/img]

[h2]Trinkets - if it shines it's mine [/h2]

These are powerful items that affect your stats. You can improve your defense, attack and ranged attack. They can also affect the number of fields you can cover in one move, a many other properties that you will discover on your own. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/f61b9bbea41c86562100d91fce048c3a05b433d6.gif[/img]

[h2]Shop and upgrade [/h2]

From time to time, you will meet Vendor and Forger on your way. There are powerful items waiting for you in the shop, so make sure you have enough coins. In the forge, you can make powerful items even more powerful. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/00ff8b01e6f6b656153cba62390a709cf8a4c08f.gif[/img]

[h2]Chests - open and pull out the card [/h2]

The chests contain a lot of useful items. Here you will find more powerful weapons, trinkets that will improve your statistics or the number of fields you can cover in one move, as well as gold for which you can buy valuable items. You decide which card you take, it's your tactic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/45d56c3cd9f9ddcb6a2e2b51207b08642a0deebd.gif[/img]

[h2]Feats - you deserved a reward [/h2]

As you try, and fail, and try again, and fail again, you will unlock new items that can spawn during runs, as well as new playable characters with unique skills and a set of initial stats. 

[h2]Power-ups - this is forever [/h2]

Each match will award you points that you can spend on power-ups. This will stay with you forever. Unlocked power-ups will be active in each subsequent game. 

 

These are just some of the systems that will help you reach the top of the tower. Is it better to attack, run away, buy items? You will have to find your own way to join the pantheon of gods.

notes.title: Welcome to The Tower!
notes.notes:
Your journey to glory starts here! Reach the top of the tower and you will join the pantheon of Gods. 

In 100 Steps, the goal is simple, but execution can be a challenge. You have 100 steps at your disposal that count as actions. It doesn't matter if you take a step, attack an enemy, open a chest, or talk to a Vendor, the counter goes down. 

In this game, your choices matter, and while sometimes powerful artifacts can be found hidden in the nooks and crannies, you'll have to manage your steps carefully. 

[h1][b]First, choose a hero [/b][/h1]

100 Steps offers 10 unique heroes, each with specific initiation statistics, equipment and skills. This will be important when choosing the right tactic. 

Let's look at three of them. 

[h2]Adventurer [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/41e4aee7ca1a328fa9ec7f9117f3cb9101307a0c.png[/img]

His origin is a mystery, but his purpose is clear: to confront the dark forces that threaten the realm. Each defeated enemy reveals more of his own latent power and the ancient prophecy that guides him.  

His weapon gleams with the promise of great feats, and his heart beats to the rhythm of the adventures that await him in his quest for truth and the salvation of the kingdom. 

[h2]Ritualist [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/a3911239d01ee6b6d80e70bc5c5b18b0e3f4cc4c.png[/img]

A devotee of the ancient religion of Nha’dhornal, this being dedicated their life to the mysterious rituals and sacred practices surrounding the power of blood. 

As a Ritualist, they possess the ability to channel the power of blood in mystical ways and summon ancestral energies and unleashing powerful spells. 

[h2]Hermit [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/37306129e4f4af06e1421bbcfcaff925ca22cf6f.png[/img]

An ancient soul that has found its refuge in nature, this being lives in harmony with the forces and creatures that surround it. Its white mask with horns is a symbol of its connection to primordial forces. 

Through its deep bond with nature, it has acquired the rare gift of absorbing the energy of its surroundings and transforming into a giant beast of immense power.
